title: A Girl from Cucamonga and the Double Whammy dispute
summary: Who decided what was recorded; Girl from Cucamonga as an Oop-Oop-A-Doo takeoff, and Freddie King's chart hit with Double Whammy that Ridgley plans to pursue through an attorney.
